home.title: Chosen Picachu
home.description: Tutorials on accordions, z-index, drag sort, charts and tables, built from this site’s own code, and a record of how the web got its three languages.

accordions.title: Accordions · Chosen Picachu
accordions.description: An accordion in HTML alone, the old ways it was built, what the platform gives now, and which of the three languages each job needed.

z-index.title: Z-index · Chosen Picachu
z-index.description: Why a z-index of 9999 can still lose: stacking contexts, what they trap, and the top layer as the browser’s way out.

drag-and-drop.title: Drag sort · Chosen Picachu
drag-and-drop.description: A list arranged by hand, by pointer on the platform’s own drag and drop and by keyboard, built step by step.

charts.title: Charts · Chosen Picachu
charts.description: A price line, candles, pressure and a pie built from a live trade feed, each as a story with the real code beside it.

tables.title: Tables · Chosen Picachu
tables.description: A trader’s table that keeps itself current, built in React and in vanilla script, step by step from the need.

a-box-remembers-the-fold.title: A box remembers the fold · Accordions · Chosen Picachu
a-box-remembers-the-fold.description: A hidden input holds whether the fold is open, and a rule collapses its panel while the input is unchecked.

the-measured-height.title: The measured height · Accordions · Chosen Picachu
the-measured-height.description: A script measures the text, and the style sheet slides the panel to that height.

what-else-forms-a-stacking-context.title: What else forms a stacking context · Z-index · Chosen Picachu
what-else-forms-a-stacking-context.description: Opacity, a transform, isolation, and position: fixed or sticky each form a stacking context on their own; an outline, a border, or position: relative or absolute without a z-index does not.

why-9999-still-loses.title: Why 9999 still loses · Z-index · Chosen Picachu
why-9999-still-loses.description: A list with z-index: 9999 opens under a card with z-index: 1, because a z-index counts only inside its stacking context.

why-third-is-on-top.title: Why Third is on top · Z-index · Chosen Picachu
why-third-is-on-top.description: With no z-index, the browser paints positioned boxes in the order the code lists them, so the last one is on top.

price.title: Price line · Charts · Chosen Picachu
price.description: The trader can watch the price move, live.

candles.title: Candles · Charts · Chosen Picachu
candles.description: The trader can read the same trades as candles.

pressure.title: Pressure · Charts · Chosen Picachu
pressure.description: The trader can see who is driving the move.

pie.title: Pie · Charts · Chosen Picachu
pie.description: The trader can see who owns the session.

sort.title: Drag sort · Tables · Chosen Picachu
sort.description: The trader can drag the columns and rows into the order they think in.

menu.title: Sort menu · Tables · Chosen Picachu
menu.description: The trader can sort the lookbacks by any measure, or take the order back.

resize.title: Drag resize · Tables · Chosen Picachu
resize.description: The trader can widen a column, and its neighbor gives up the room.

the-need-and-its-clues.title: The need and its clues · Tables · Chosen Picachu
the-need-and-its-clues.description: A trader says what they need, and its clues show that a table is the element built for it.

the-sketch.title: The sketch · Tables · Chosen Picachu
the-sketch.description: A sketch of the table, drawn from the need before any code.

the-slices.title: The slices · Tables · Chosen Picachu
the-slices.description: The story is too big to build at once, so it is cut into slices, the smallest table first.

the-still-table.title: The still table · Tables · Chosen Picachu
the-still-table.description: The smallest table that honors the shape, so the trader can read the market.

the-live-table-and-the-store.title: The live table and the store · Tables · Chosen Picachu
the-live-table-and-the-store.description: The trader watches the market live, one lookback beside another, from a store both builds share.

users.title: Users · Chosen Picachu
users.description: A roster of candidates and the form that adds one, with the platform’s own validation.

gallery.title: Gallery · Chosen Picachu
gallery.description: A wall of artworks from the Art Institute of Chicago, the Victoria and Albert Museum and Harvard’s collections.

record.title: The record · Chosen Picachu
record.descriptionTemplate: How the web got its three languages, in {moments} moments from 1989 on, each with its fuller story and its sources.

structure.title: Structure · Practice · Chosen Picachu
structure.description: How I organize structure: the element for the content, named landmarks, and the page read with its styles off.

presentation.title: Presentation · Practice · Chosen Picachu
presentation.description: How I organize presentation: a component’s structure in a style sheet beside it, everything else shared, and a class list that reads like a sentence.

behavior.title: Behavior · Practice · Chosen Picachu
behavior.description: How I organize behavior: what is true and what happened, a functional core under an imperative shell, and a keyboard twin for every pointer action.

closedSite.description: Part of the frame around every page broke, so no page can open right now.
